markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (95%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Priority tier 1 surgical frozen section with flagged resampling degradation, model disagreement, and drafted recut and deeper-level orders.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 95%, InSitu 4%, Benign 1%, Normal 0% [F1] | High invasive score; dataset ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (90% target, 90% test coverage) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability, 100% OOD, flagged [F6] | Suspect resampled input (error AUROC 70%) |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%) [F5] | Mostly invasive; InSitu contrast at 75% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.33, contribution +0.77) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 1) · context · Below-typical score (-0.15, contribution +0.62) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (0.04, contribution +0.40) [F4]; 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score (0.08, contribution +0.29); caption inconsistent; 18/20 spot check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (1.20, contribution +0.27); 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Resampling degradation (severity 3, 44% reliability, 100% OOD) distorts tissue, explaining why CONCH and MUSK disagree.
- True lesion is InSitu (4%), matching contrast case BACH_0253 (75% similarity; differs in TILs and normal lobules).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 9**: Verify stromal invasion versus InSitu or resampling artifact (cells disabled).
2. **Regions 3, 11, 1**: Compare benign stroma/lobules (**3, 11**) and TILs (**1**) against InSitu contrast BACH_0253.
3. **Regions 0, 7, 8**: Defer margin call to permanent sections [F7]; review drafted recut and deeper-level orders.
